data.title: 雷电将军 · 花海逆光
data.description: 晚风吹过郊野的波斯菊，雷电影穿着长袖紫色便裙，在花田小径上停下脚步。她回身望向你，紫色长辫垂在肩后，辫梢与衣裙一同被风轻轻带起。夕阳沿着她的侧脸镀出暖边，花海在身后缓缓摇动，她伸出一只空着的手，像是邀请你把剩下的路一起走完。
data.action: 站在花田小径上回身伸手，长辫与裙摆随晚风轻扬，露出温柔浅笑。
data.camera: medium shot, eye level, meadow extending behind subject
data.promptProse: Between swaying cosmos flowers, Raiden Ei stops on the narrow meadow path and turns to invite the viewer forward with an open hand. Her long-sleeved purple dress moves in the breeze, and the familiar single braid rests behind her shoulder. A gentle smile softens her face as low sunset light traces its edge. Use a medium view with a broad stretch of flowers behind her, holding the quiet pause before they continue along the path.
